messages:
maya: Heads-up — Jenkins e2e perf gate (job: `e2e/throughput-smoke`) failed on main. p95 latency jumped ~2.3x compared to baseline. cc @aj @sam :eyes:
aj: saw the alert, can you paste the job link and the failing metric output?
maya: job link: https://jenkins.redwood-inference.internal/job/e2e-throughput-smoke/742/console. Error snippet: ```P95 latency: baseline=48ms current=112ms (+133%) throughput stable ~430r/s```
sam: ugh. Was there any config drift? batching or kv-cache changes in last deploy?
leo: I can check recent model-serving PRs — 2 deployments in the last 6 hours. One was #3247 (dynamic-batch tuning) and #3251 (kernel selection tweak).
ci-bot: Repro artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/e2e/742/{metrics.json,perf-trace.pbz}.
nina: @maya can you rerun the job with `/rerun`? We should confirm flake vs regression before bisect.
maya: scheduling a rerun now with the same seed + more verbose traces. I'll also attach the commit sha: fc3d9a2 (deployed earlier).
aj: if rerun fails, we should bisect between fc3d9a2 and the previous green commit e9b7c11. Sam/Leo — any objections to me owning the bisect?
sam: go for it, aj. If we can isolate to PR level that's ideal. Also try a rerun with `--disable-kv-cache` to see cache impact.
leo: quick check: dynamic-batch default went from 64->128 in #3247, that could increase latency variance at p95 for short sequences.
maya: rerun finished — result: still failing, p95=109ms. Marked as red.
aj: starting bisect now. I'll run bisect script against ci artifacts, expect ~30-45m. Posting updates in thread.
sam: thanks. Also pinging infra oncall to see if there was any GPU noisy neighbor or node degradation around that window. @aj can you include cluster node ids in bisect?
aj: will include node ids and kernel logs. If bisect points to #3247 we may need a quick revert or tweak batching heuristics.
leo: note to self: prepare a canary with batch cap=64 and run smoke to compare.
nina: thanks all. If anyone finds a short-term mitigation, please post the rollback PR link here. :thumbsup:
